description: Works a tracker's open issues from new to fixed, one stage at a time: triage, maintainer decisions, investigation, then fixes. Shows how many issues sit in each state and runs the next stage. Use for "work through the backlog" or "what's next on the tracker". For one known issue, use `issue-triage`, `investigate-bug` or `issue-resolve`.
